H7.interpretation: KL early stopping produced a large internal mirror gain but failed registered endpoint value-calibration and KL-p95 gates.

H8.interpretation: Catch-up value updates magnified internal mirror gains but worsened primary calibration and failed both KL stability gates, supporting an upstream critic-update robustness question.

external_comparators.conclusion: The clean H8 endpoint is not an external model candidate and is materially below all current comparators by point estimate; CAL-EXT precision does not authorize a method or action-specific causal claim.

loss_localization.interpretation: Repeated extreme action frequencies and realized losses are important diagnostics but do not identify the EV of unchosen calls or raises.

Path1.interpretation: Healthy asset generation, but incomplete and still diagnostic-only; it cannot be ingested or outrank the ready controlled critic question.

single_variable.name: catchup_value_loss
single_variable.treatment: SmoothL1 beta=1.0 raw critic-v1 bb unit

decision.rationale: The external catastrophe makes continuation without measurement indefensible but does not identify a specific action fix. H7/H8 give controlled evidence that value catch-up and KL behavior are unstable, while H9 never tested the preregistered robust-loss remedy. A fresh exact rerun is therefore the smallest prospective causal test; the H8 checkpoint is used only as a same-start training source, not adopted as a model candidate.
requirements: Create a new post-CAL H10 preregistration; the pre-CAL H10 registration remains superseded.
Use fresh run directories and exact H8 source for both arms; never use H9 partial latest.pt.
Keep fixed20M per arm, control-first order, beta1.0 and every H9 statistical gate unchanged.
Freeze exact implementation/tool hashes, active-window sentinel and process isolation before launch.
No Slumbot, mirror, evaluator or delegated project-script execution during either active arm.
If H10 PASSes, run exact-endpoint quick5k before promotion; the current catastrophic external flag blocks automatic promotion absent a clean new endpoint quick5k and all registered quality gates.
No extension, second seed, later endpoint or official hands during H10 arms.
